thread:
rafa_sales: FYI - Prospect 'HarborTech' wants absolute EU + Canada residency: inference, logs, and customer keys must never leave the selected region. They prefer hosted but will take Dedicated/Private if needed. Need quick guidance for presales: cost delta, timeline, and a short config snippet.

anil_engineer: Hosted can tenant-pin requests to eu/ca model pools. Logs can be routed to regional sinks. Control plane is global by default; to guarantee control-plane data never leaves region you need Private or an engineered hosted isolation (not standard).

marta_privsec: Legal asks for: full subprocessor roster for EU/CA, BYO-KMS confirmation, written attestation that audit logs remain in-region, and a DPA clause for no cross-border egress. Also want confirmation on whether metrics/telemetry contain PII.

ben_ops: Ops options: 1) Hosted tenant-pin with "no-fallback" (we disable cross-border failover). Risk: availability if regional capacity drops. Mitigations: reserve capacity in both regions or Dedicated pools. ETA: hosted pin + regional pools ~2-3w. KMS proxy if needed +5d.

rafa_sales: Can you give a short uplift estimate I can put in the SOW?

anil_engineer: Ballpark: hosted hard-pin = +16-20% usage uplift (packing inefficiency + reserved headroom). Dedicated reduces per-unit uplift but comes with monthly commit. Private/control-plane-in-region = multi-week project + infra fee.

marta_privsec: BYO-KMS caveat: for hosted we support cloud CMKs, but if control plane remains global, key policies must permit cross-region envelope ops or we deploy a regional key-proxy which keeps keys in-region. If customer insists absolutely no cross-border key material access, Private is the safe option.

ben_ops: Quick example snippet you can share with the customer:

routing_policy: tenant_pin; regions=[eu-west-1,ca-central-1]; fallback=none
kms: byo=true; mode=regional-proxy
logs: sink=regional; retention=customer-specified

ticket-bot: TKT-88221 created: "HarborTech - EU/CA tenant pin + KMS proxy prep"

marta_privsec: I'll assemble a draft subprocessor attestation and DPA paragraph. If we need to support absolute zero cross-border for the control plane, legal + infra need 4-6w for Private deployment plan.

rafa_sales: Great — I'll present two options to the customer: A) Hosted tenant-pin (no-fallback) + ~18% uplift, faster (~3w) B) Dedicated/Private for full isolation (longer lead, custom pricing). Linking legal and ops. Thanks all :thumbsup:
